contract_dimensions.historical_simulator: decide() called on date T-1 with market_state containing bars up to & including T-1 close.
contract_dimensions.prospective_runner: decide() called at 16:00:00 ET upon receiving confirmed T-1 daily close bars.
contract_dimensions.quantification_and_impact: Zero lookahead drift. Both harnesses enforce identical causality boundary.

contract_dimensions.historical_simulator: Orders returned by decide() queued to pending list.
contract_dimensions.prospective_runner: Orders logged to immutable pending journal with cryptographic intent hash.
contract_dimensions.quantification_and_impact: Zero discrepancy. Orders wait for Session T market open.

contract_dimensions.historical_simulator: Orders filled at Session T open via open_on(ticker, date) with modeled slippage.
contract_dimensions.prospective_runner: Orders filled against Session T market open bar print with modeled slippage.
contract_dimensions.quantification_and_impact: Fill price is exactly open_price * (1 +/- slippage). Long-only affordance strictly enforced.

contract_dimensions.historical_simulator: 5 bps (0.0005) for standard equity ETFs; 10 bps (0.0010) for 2x/3x leveraged ETFs.
contract_dimensions.prospective_runner: Configurable slippage model defaulting to 5 bps equity ETF / 10 bps leveraged ETF.
contract_dimensions.quantification_and_impact: Identical slippage penalty applied to all buy and sell order executions.

contract_dimensions.historical_simulator: Long-only, no margin debt. If cost > cash, qty scaled down to cash / fill price.
contract_dimensions.prospective_runner: CashAffordabilityEngine verifies liquid cash balance before execution; caps buys to available cash.
contract_dimensions.quantification_and_impact: Zero overdraft risk. Cash balance is strictly non-negative across all simulated sessions.

contract_dimensions.historical_simulator: Orders rejected if ticker is not present in regime bars dictionary.
contract_dimensions.prospective_runner: Orders rejected unless ticker is in AUTHORIZED_UNIVERSE frozenset.
contract_dimensions.quantification_and_impact: Both engines strictly isolate execution to authorized sector ETF universe.

contract_dimensions.historical_simulator: If close_on or open_on returns None, order/pricing skipped without aborting simulator.
contract_dimensions.prospective_runner: Ingests missing-bar event; <= 2 missing bars hold position; >= 3 missing bars trip state quarantine.
contract_dimensions.quantification_and_impact: Prospective engine adds explicit fail-closed quarantine while maintaining historical fallback behavior.

contract_dimensions.historical_simulator: Uses unadjusted daily OHLCV bars from sample_regimes.json.gz; cash dividends not automatically credited.
contract_dimensions.prospective_runner: Vendor feeds typically provide split-adjusted prices or cash dividend distribution events.
contract_dimensions.quantification_and_impact: Discrepancy quantified: If prospective feed uses split-adjusted close while historical feed used raw close, small cash dividend yield difference (approx 1.5% - 2.0% annualized) occurs. Protocol specifies: prospective feed must use split-adjusted close and credit explicit cash dividends to cash balance upon ex-dividend date.

contract_dimensions.historical_simulator: Assumes static split-adjusted historical series in sample_regimes.json.gz.
contract_dimensions.prospective_runner: Includes explicit CorporateActionSplit handler that scales position quantity and divides average cost.
contract_dimensions.quantification_and_impact: Prospective engine handles corporate splits dynamically without position value discontinuities.

contract_dimensions.historical_simulator: Tracks peak equity curve: mdd = max(mdd, (peak - v) / peak). Blow-up at mdd > 0.50.
contract_dimensions.prospective_runner: Tracks peak equity curve with identical mathematical formula.
contract_dimensions.quantification_and_impact: Mathematical formula is identical to machine precision.

contract_dimensions.prospective_runner: Beta-adjusted exposure monitor enforces identical 1.50x ceiling.
contract_dimensions.quantification_and_impact: D2 candidate utilizes maximum 1.0x gross exposure (50% equities, 50% cash), well below 1.5x cap.

contract_dimensions.historical_simulator: Single position >= 30% for > 5 consecutive trading days triggers breach.
contract_dimensions.prospective_runner: Concentration monitor tracks consecutive-day streaks >= 30% with identical 5-day breach threshold.
contract_dimensions.quantification_and_impact: D2 defensive basket allocates ~16.67% across XLP, XLU, XLV (well below 30% single-stock ceiling).
